Only 22% of remote USD jobs list a salary. The rest say DOE—here's what that means for your next negotiation.

According to Loker Dollar's analysis of 4,280 active remote listings, 940 (22%) disclose a pay figure, while 3,340 (78%) leave it blank, signaling a DOE (determined on experience) arrangement. This means your compensation is set after the employer reviews your résumé and skills.

But DOE isn't a red flag. In fields like AI or specialized healthcare, it can push salaries above market averages for top candidates. Use these tips: research global benchmarks, quantify your impact, anchor with a high range, ask about total comp, and reference industry trends.

Real-world example: Online Consumer Panels America offers $25–$45/hour for product assessments. Only 1 of 7 sampled listings had a disclosed range.

Ready to find DOE roles that match your skills? Browse 449 open Operations roles, 109 posted this week, on Loker Dollar. https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/what-is-doe-wage
